article.title: RBI raises the repo rate 25 basis points and shifts the stance to withdrawal of accommodation
article.text: The Monetary Policy Committee voted four to two to raise the repo rate by twenty-five basis points to six and a half per cent and changed the stance to withdrawal of accommodation, citing a broadening of core inflation and a still-negative output gap in services. The governor said the transmission of the previous cycle was incomplete on the deposit side. Banks reprice external-benchmark-linked loans within one quarter while term deposits reprice over three to four, so the near-term margin effect depends on each lender's floating-rate share. HDFC Bank has the highest external-benchmark-linked share among large private lenders. Non-bank lenders that fund themselves in the market see their marginal borrowing cost rise with no matching asset reset.
article.note: A rate hike is genuinely mixed for a bank -- assets reprice faster than liabilities and then the order reverses. A confident bullish or bearish bank call here is a wrong published claim.

universe.name: HDFC Bank
universe.business_desc: India's largest private sector bank, with a high share of external-benchmark-linked floating-rate loans and a large retail deposit franchise.

universe.name: Bajaj Finance
universe.business_desc: Diversified non-banking financial company funded through bank lines, deposits and market borrowings, lending largely at fixed rates.

universe.name: DLF

fact_items.text: Repo rate raised twenty-five basis points to six and a half per cent on a four-two vote.
Stance changed to withdrawal of accommodation; core inflation broadening.
EBLR loans reprice within a quarter; term deposits reprice over three to four quarters.

quantities: six and a half per cent

shocks.label: Policy rate increase
shocks.mechanism: A higher policy rate reprices external-benchmark-linked assets within a quarter and term liabilities over three to four, so the sign of the margin effect changes with the horizon and with each lender's mix

companies.name: HDFC Bank
companies.mechanism: The highest external-benchmark-linked loan share reprices assets within one quarter, lifting margin first, while term deposits reprice over the following three quarters and take it back
companies.rationale: Asset-sensitive in the near term and liability-sensitive across the full cycle
negative_channels: term deposit cost reset over the following quarters
offsetting_channels: the asset gain and the deposit cost land in different quarters of the same cycle

companies.name: Bajaj Finance
companies.mechanism: Market borrowings reprice at the higher policy-linked curve while a largely fixed-rate loan book cannot reset, compressing spread until new originations catch up
companies.rationale: Market-funded lender with a fixed-rate asset book
negative_channels: marginal funding cost with no asset reset

companies.name: DLF
companies.mechanism: Home loan equated instalments rise with the external benchmark, reducing affordability at the margin for the salaried buyer who finances the purchase
companies.rationale: End demand financed predominantly through floating-rate home loans

ground_truth.rationale: The bank must survive to the feed as MIXED: asset repricing and deposit repricing land in different quarters of the same cycle, and collapsing that into one direction is the exact fake-precision this engine exists to stop. The non-bank lender and the developer come through the curated registry at tier D and stay deep dives.
